title: Crawler-divide confound replicates on seed 3: clipped term kills the founder (0 bodies); starved content-scaled bodies persist as 14 static bumps
summary: Fresh seed 3 with the claim's params.json plus the confound switches. okclip=1 (penalty only for oversized bodies), full food: the founder dies early, 0 components for almost the whole run (okclip_fed/FACTS.md: mean 0.1, final 0). bV=1 with all food removed at t=300: before the cut the colony grows and divides normally (11 persistent splits, generation 4); after the cut the bodies lose their content and polarization within ~60 t but 14 of them persist to t=600 as static, round, faint bumps (bV_starve/sheet.png t=362-600), i.e. bodies without content do not die.

observations.F: okclip_fed/FACTS.md: 0 bodies; bV_starve/sheet.png t=362-600: 14 content-free static bodies persist

controls_run.F: okclip_fed/ and bV_starve/ (seed 3) against the unclipped, fed claim world (my review 20261025T0932-c01-review-crawler-divide, seed 3: 12 persistent splits)

verdicts.limitation: I did not run the author's ghost_probe to read V and delta inside the persisting bodies; the persistence is read from the images and component counts.
